products.title: Sediment and Ion Bidet Water Filters
products.body_html:
Sediment Bidet Water Filter
Designed to trap larger particulate matter such as debris, sand, rust, and other sediments, this filter is ideal for most installations. It protects your bidet by preventing impurities from entering the system, reducing the risk of damage and leaks.

Ion Bidet Water Filter
This advanced filter not only captures sediments but also neutralizes harmful ions and impurities in the water. It’s the perfect choice for users in areas with mineral-rich water, ensuring a longer lifespan for your bidet seat.

Why Use a Bidet Water Filter?
Water impurities are the leading cause of damage and leaks in bidet seats, leading to costly repairs or replacements. Installing a water filter ensures clean water flow, safeguarding your bidet’s performance and durability.

Key Features:

  • Captures sediment, sand, and rust to protect bidet components.
  • Ion filters neutralize harmful ions in mineral-rich water.
  • Meets strict manufacturer guidelines, highly recommended for all bidet seats.
  • Universal 1/2″ fittings (male and female) compatible with most bidets.
  • Long-lasting performance: Purifies up to 410 gallons or 1,500 flushes.
  • Replace every 6 to 9 months for optimal filtration.

Choose between sediment or ion filters to keep your bidet seat performing like new while ensuring clean, impurity-free water.
